So I think this sums up basic sequence generation:

1. Sequence is generated from the 55 tile pool, tiles are selected at random. (In this example let's assume board tiles = 26)
2. There are weights assigned, despite being randomly selected. This is for both hand tiles and board tiles. The 2 sets of weights will have an overlap %. We allow the game designer to set the weights, but we constantly compute the overlapping % between the weights. The overlapping % is simply the sum of the smaller % weight of the 2 sets.
